sn35.113:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
sn35.113:1.2: atha kho bhagavā rahogato paṭisallīno imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ abhāsi.
sn35.113:1.3: cakkhuṃ paṭicca rūpe cuppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.113:1.10: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti. sotañca paṭicca …pe… ghānañca paṭicca …pe…
sn35.113:1.12: manañca paṭicca dhamme cuppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.113:2.1: cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe cuppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.113:2.8: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti. sotañca paṭicca …pe… ghānañca paṭicca …pe…
sn35.113:2.10: manañca paṭicca dhamme cuppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.113:3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhagavato upassutiṃ ṭhito hoti.
sn35.113:3.2: addasā kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upassutiṃ ṭhitaṃ.
sn35.113:3.4: assosi no tvaṃ bhikkhu imaṃ dhammapariyāyanti?
